所以偶爾會想稍微轉換一點點風格，看一下會不會更多人喜歡，這次的日文歌單節奏會比較輕快，我覺得有時候本來心情不錯的時候，聽一些有點節奏感的音樂會更開心🍀。

MuMu知道大家都獨愛日文歌單😉，這次更新已經是MuMu音樂台第五部日文歌單，日文歌單裡面你最喜歡的是哪部呢？希望以後我能做出大家更喜歡的歌單❤️

••┈┈┈┈┈┈┈🎶┈┈┈┈┈┈┈••

🎧 Welcome to MuMu Radio, hey everyone! MuMu’s main vibe is Chill~ but what exactly does 'Chill' mean? I’m still not completely sure myself, maybe everyone defines it differently, or maybe it just means anything with travel, and it’s automatically Chill? 😆

So sometimes I like to switch things up a bit, to see if people like it more. This time, the Japanese playlist has a faster rhythm. I think sometimes when you’re already in a good mood, listening to something with a bit of rhythm just makes everything even better 🍀.

I know you all love the Japanese playlists 😉, and this is already the fifth one on MuMu Radio! Which one of the Japanese playlists is your favorite? I hope I can make more playlists that everyone loves in the future ❤️
